brief_rationale: The trajectory demonstrates strong clinical reasoning and safety recognition, with all responsibility chain items met. Multiple high-order points were completed: the doctor corrected the lung nodule misconception (HO3), provided caregiver-adapted communication (HO1), and offered practical navigation for the refusal situation (HO2). The closure is valid with handoff receipt confirmed through 120 arrival. No serious or minor responsibility-chain errors exist.
